result:
Done. Tracked tree is clean, both fixes committed.

## Run 85 (s2 frontend-test) — results

**1 real defect found and fixed, plus a recovered fix from the capped s1 stage.**

### `ba35464` — recovered s1's uncommitted work (`git status` first action, 4th payout in 5 nights)
s1 hit `max_turns` at 51/50 mid-commit, leaving a complete two-bug fix in the tree. I verified it before committing: both files parse, `documents.tags` really is JSONB (`017_notifications.sql:106`), and the `JSON.stringify` idiom matches every other jsonb write. The bugs: an unguarded `JSON.parse` on multipart `tags` answered **500 instead of 400**, and node-postgres serialized the array as `{a,b}` so **every tagged upload failed with 22P02**.

### `23e106d` — "Sign Now" was dead on a *new* estimate
`/estimates` → New Estimate → Review & Share → Sign Now. `EstimateBuilder` takes `estimate` as a **prop**, so it never changes. The handler created the row but **discarded the response**, then set `showSignModal(true)` — while `signModal` was gated on the still-null prop. The user got a toast, a real DB row, and no modal. Fixed by gating on `estimate || createdEstimate`; that value also feeds the "have I saved yet" guard, so a second click no longer creates a second row. Verified live both ways, and I re-checked that Run 84's existing-estimate path didn't regress.

This is the **4th dead control on that one toolbar in 3 runs** — I've flagged it in memory as the app's top hot spot.

**Method worth reusing:** I proved the defect with **zero DB writes** by stubbing the POST with `page.route` → fake 201. That works even on tables with no DELETE route, which matters here.

### Coverage
All 19 routes render with **0 page errors, 0 white screens, 0 native `<select>`/`input[type=date]`, 0 horizontal overflow**. Verified working: dashboard stat-card navigation (incl. `?stage=sold`, which `/leads` genuinely consumes), leads search/sort/CSV/pagination, all 13 Settings tabs, pipeline drag (with revert, net-zero), all 5 report presets, calendar views, 6 storm-map layer toggles, invoice filters. FEMA map code untouched.

### Two things to flag
- **Tasks toggle-complete is untested, deliberately.** There are 0 tasks and no DELETE route for tasks, so creating one would leave a permanent row in the free-tier DB. The empty state renders correctly; a future run should use the stub technique instead.
- **`ba35464` is committed but not live** — the API server runs without a watcher, and I didn't restart it since that's your process.

Three false leads I chased and killed rather than filed: the pipeline board looked completely dead until I learned raw `page.mouse` events don't drive HTML5 DnD (`locator.dragTo()` works fine); "Property Report" reads as dead to a DOM metric but returns 200 and opens a blob tab; "New Estimate" moved only -77 chars because it swaps in a full-page builder. All four traps are now in the standing gotchas.
